scores.evidence: The 3 objectives use observable verbs (まとめられる / 判断できる / 説明できる). Each has 2 or more questions with objectiveId: o1 has q2, q3, e1 and e2; o2 has q1, q5, q6 and e3; o3 has q4, e5 and e6. Both e1 (team sharing) and e3 (finding old code before swapping a library) are apply-or-higher transfer items. The create level of o1 is checked only by pr-checklist (「説明文に「何をするか」と「いつ使うか」が書いてあります」).

hook-b1 sets a concrete problem in 3 sentences (「コミットの前に、毎回同じ手順をClaude Codeに貼り付けていませんか。」), and the ungraded hook-q leads into 7-1. But hook-q mostly asks learners to recall lesson 6 (its explanation says 「（第6回）」). The second problem in hook-b1, research output flooding the conversation, gets no prediction.

The prerequisites name lessons 5 and 6, and the text recalls them where they are used (「（第6回）」 in s1-lead and hook-q, 「（第5回）」 in s3-lead). The new terms are defined with their English in s1-defs (スキル, フロントマター, 段階的な読み込み) and s3-defs (サブエージェント, フォーク), and 拡張機能 is defined in s4-lead. These definitions match the glossary. YAML is glossed inline (「「項目名: 値」の形で設定を書く書式」).

measure.mjs still reports 「prose 2167 (budget 1,200–2,400) · est 17.8 min (must be ≤ 20; estMinutes 18)」, and lint --strict gives 0 errors and 0 warnings after the q6 change. Section 7-3 is the densest: subagent, fork, background default and the agent file come in 7 blocks before its check. The unexplained `>-` sentence in ex-description also adds load.

7-2 is a full worked example before practice. s2-steps has 5 labelled steps, each with its reason (「起動後に `.claude/skills/` を新しく作ると、`/reload-skills` するまで読み込まれないためです」, 「Claudeは説明文で使うかを決めるので」), plus a prediction in ex-auto. There is no faded example. The subagent half of the practice is shown only as s3-how's one-line phrasing.

Every content section has an inline quiz, and q1, q3, q4, q5 and now q6 need inference. q6 (evaluate) can no longer be solved by matching words: option b (「毎週チャットで一から説明し直している」) has to be recognised as the 「同じ依頼文や手順書を何度も貼っている」 trigger in s4-table, and c (「もう読まない出力で会話の大半が埋まった」) as the subagent trigger. Option d (「すべてスキルにしておく」) is a fair lure because it echoes the prompt's 「スキルにする」, and s4-pitfall is what refutes it. Every wrong option has feedback. One weakness remains: q2's answer is the key that s2-invoke names just before it.

The q6 feedback still fits the rewritten options. a's feedback 「規約やコマンドのまちがいは、CLAUDE.mdに足すきっかけです。」 corrects the 'a repeated command error needs a skill' idea, and c's 「あとで見返さない出力で会話が埋まるのは、サブエージェントのきっかけです。」 matches the new c. d's 「きっかけのない拡張機能は、説明文のぶんだけコンテキストを使い続けます。」 corrects the 'set everything up now' idea. Elsewhere unchanged: all 7 misconceptions in the brief appear as distractors with corrective feedback of 2 sentences or fewer (q2 b, q4 c, q5 b, e2 a), and s4-pitfall names the 「最初に全部そろえる」 mistake.

s1-diagram (5 nodes) and s3-diagram (4 nodes) show a process, and their captions state the takeaway (「読んだ中身はサブエージェント側に残り、メインの会話には要約だけが戻る」). There are no decorative images. But the s1-diagram labels say 「読む」 while the lesson's term is 読み込む (段階的な読み込み). Its alt also describes a branch the diagram does not draw (「それ以外では本文は読み込まれない」), and that is the contrast q1 tests.

The task is authentic: the learner turns their own repeated work into a skill, then compares `/context` before and after delegating. All 7 pr-steps have an expect, pr-prompt gives the delegation text, pr-checklist sets 5 success criteria and pr-model/pr-model-lead give a model answer with its reason. pr-write has only one hint rung (「7-2の `commit-message` を手本に、中身を入れ替えます。」) before the full model answer.

summary-points (4 points) comes after the exam. summary-next has a lesson-specific reflection (「スキルにしたい手順と、サブエージェントに任せたい調べものを1つずつ挙げてみましょう」) and names the next lesson by its exact title. It is followed by 6 flashcards and 3 askTutor suggestions.

The 4 confirmed findings in audit-cc-07-skills-subagents.json are all applied: q5 d (「スキルはふだん今の会話の中で動くため、脇では進みません。」), q2 d (「フロントマターなどの設定で決めます」), e6 c (「主に」), and the s4 caption is gone. s4-main matches sub-agents.md ("A subagent that isn't a fork starts fresh and may need time to gather context"), and the versions are pinned (v2.1.304, v2.1.198). The text uses です・ます and is warm (「まず予想してみましょう」), and lint finds no banned phrases or long sentences. Katakana terms carry their English on first use (サブエージェント（subagent）, バックグラウンド（background）). Minor inconsistency: s1-diagram's 「読む」 vs 「読み込まれる」 in the text. The ja-editor owns the wording.
